tables.title: Control of the common clock generation(1)
tables.text: Table 298, "Control of the common clock generation(1)", in section 36.4.5 (Clock generator (CKGEN)) on page 1717. Columns: CCKyEN, CCKyDIR, Description. 3 data row(s). Notes: 1. The configuration with CCKyEN = 1 and CCyDIR = 0 is not shown must be avoided (no interest).

rows:
The ADF_CCKy pin is in input. An external clock can be connected to the ADF_CCKypin 
and used by the SITF0 in order to decode the serial stream
The ADF_CCKy pin is in output. No clock is generated. The ADF_CCKy pin is driven low.

The ADF_CCKy pin is in output. A clock is generated on the ADF_CCKy pin. The SITF0 
can use this pin as clock source in order to decode the serial stream
notes: 1. The configuration with CCKyEN = 1 and CCyDIR = 0 is not shown must be avoided (no interest).
